title: I connettivi del racconto: then, so, because, but
rule: Per raccontare bastano pochi connettivi: and / and then / then per la sequenza, so per la conseguenza, because per la causa, but per il contrasto, after that / later / in the end / finally per l'ordine, while per due azioni insieme, luckily / unfortunately per il commento. Because e so non si usano nella stessa frase. Because + frase; because of + nome.

head: Connettivo
Italiano
Esempio
rows: I took the streetcar and then I walked. Then I went in.
I was early, so I walked around the block.
I was nervous because it was my first interview.
I didn't leave because of the job.
The first loaf wasn't great, but the second was.
At first Doug didn't say anything.
dopo di che · dopo · più tardi
After that, Priya gave me the dough.
Doug watched while I rolled the dough.
alla fine · infine · alla fine (dopo tanto)
In the end they called. Finally!

blocks.title: Perché: why o because?
blocks.text: L'italiano ha una parola; l'inglese due. [[Why]] fa la domanda: [[Why did you leave?]]. [[Because]] dà la risposta: [[Because I wanted something new]]. E [[so]] è la freccia in avanti: [[I wanted something new, so I left]]. Mai [[because… so…]] nella stessa frase: è la traduzione di «siccome… allora», e in inglese non esiste.

items.t: I got there early, so I walked around the block. Then I went in and met Priya.
items.n: Sono arrivata presto, quindi ho fatto il giro dell'isolato. Poi sono entrata e ho conosciuto Priya.

items.t: At first I was nervous, but after that it was fine. In the end, they called the same evening.
items.n: All'inizio ero agitata, ma dopo è andata bene. Alla fine hanno chiamato la sera stessa.

items.t: I didn't know much about sourdough, so I told the truth, because Doug likes honest people.
items.n: Non sapevo molto del lievito madre, quindi ho detto la verità, perché a Doug piacciono le persone oneste.

items.t: Unfortunately the cream melted. Luckily nobody noticed. Anyway, the cake was fine.
items.n: Purtroppo la crema si è sciolta. Per fortuna nessuno se n'è accorto. Comunque, la torta era perfetta.

items.wrong: Because I was early, so I walked.
items.right: I was early, so I walked. / Because I was early, I walked.

items.wrong: because of it was late · because the rain
items.right: because it was late · because of the rain
After that, I went home. / Afterwards, I went home.
items.why: After da solo vuole un complemento.
At the end of + nome; in the end = alla fine.

items.wrong: I was nervous, why it was my first interview.
items.right: I was nervous because it was my first interview.

items.q: I was late ___ the streetcar stopped, ___ I ran. ___ I was out of breath, ___ after that I was fine.
items.n: Ero in ritardo perché il tram si è fermato, quindi ho corso. All'inizio ero senza fiato, ma dopo stavo bene.

items.q: «Perché sei andata via? — Perché volevo qualcosa di nuovo.»
options: Why did you leave? — Because I wanted something new.
Because did you leave? — Why I wanted something new.
Why did you leave? — So I wanted something new.
items.why: Why nella domanda, because nella risposta.

items.q: Luckily, in the end, they called.
answers: Luckily, in the end, they called
Luckily in the end they called
Luckily, they called in the end
